## 

Private Revolutions: Four Women Face China's New Social Order
The product of seven years of intimate, in-depth reporting, this transporting and indelible book traces the journey of four such women as they try to make better lives for themselves and their families in the new Chinese economy.

## 

Private Revolutions: Four Women Face China's New Social Order
Yuan Yang is a campaigner and former journalist standing for parliamentary selection in the Labour Party. She is a former columnist and Europe-China correspondent at the Financial Times and the cofounder of the charity Rethinking Economics, which campaigns for a more diverse and realistic economics curriculum.

## 

Private Revolutions: Four Women Face China's New Social Order
“Yang offers a fresh interpretation of the ongoing nature of China’s many upheavals, the actual effects of its oft-discussed policies, the cost of its meteoric economic growth, and the role a new generation of women is poised to play.

## 

Private Revolutions: Four Women Face China's New Social Order
Yuan Yang shows us the real China in all its complexity – the rich, detailed, often brutal life of the villages and cities. Anyone who wants to understand what China and the Chinese are like will find great pleasure, and sometimes pain, in reading it.” —John Simpson
